scripts.build: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'dist')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'dist' }; Copy-Item index.html, projector.html, app.js, projector.js, styles.css, favicon.svg, pdj_logo.png dist/ -Force; Copy-Item outputs dist/outputs -Recurse -Force; Set-Content -Path 'dist/_redirects' -Value '/* /index.html 200'"
